requirement: The enabled Habeas Symposium plugin MUST make the `habeas` CLI available in Cargo's global executable directory before its session-start hook advises an agent to run `habeas setup`.
rationale: The manifest declares a global Cargo installation and the SessionStart hook names it as its command. The released Symposium 0.5.1 does not dispatch crate-embedded hooks, so CLI acquisition before hook advice cannot yet be verified end to end.
